title: Model A — fire-and-forget with reply_to inbox
description: Initiator sends intent with reply_to = initiator's own inbox address. Does NOT call observe() — it fires and moves on. The fulfillment agent processes the order, calls resume_intent. When COMPLETED, AXME delivers the result to the initiator's reply_to inbox. The runner then reads the result from GET /v1/inbox. Tests the disconnect-safe initiator pattern.

agents.description: validates order, computes tracking ID, resumes COMPLETED — result goes to initiator inbox

intent._note: reply_to is injected by runner from initiator's SA address
